options.name: inputdir
options.summary: the folder of scripts and outputs to read

options.name: intelfile
options.summary: a watchlist, JSON or STIX 2.1, to attribute the indicators to

options.name: outdir
options.summary: where the output is saved; slopmop-<name> in the current directory when not given

options.name: secrets
options.summary: how a password, a hash, a token or a key is written; masked when not given

options.name: cores
options.summary: how much of the processors of this machine the run may use, 1 to 100; all of them when not given

options.name: memory
options.summary: how much of the memory of this machine the run tries to stay within, 1 to 100; 75 when not given

options.name: progress
options.summary: whether the run says what it is doing as it goes, on the error stream; shown on a terminal when not given

options.name: start
options.summary: reads only the files of this time or later, such as 2026-10-22 or 2026-10-22T09:30:00Z; alone, it looks forward from this time

options.name: stop
options.summary: reads only the files of this time or earlier, a day alone counted to its end; alone, it looks back from this time

verbs.name: report
verbs.summary: reads the folder and everything below it, runs nothing, prints the report and saves it

sections.name: timeline
sections.title: Timeline
sections.summary: what was done, in order of time: each period of files that show the same tactics

sections.name: intents
sections.title: Intents
sections.summary: each ARTEX intent, by its run folder i<number>: its period and its ATT&CK and ATLAS techniques
sections.note: an ARTEX run folder i<number>: the first and last time of its files, and the techniques found in them

sections.name: findings
sections.title: Findings
sections.summary: each activity, indicator and tactic, most severe first

sections.name: files
sections.title: Notable files
sections.summary: the files that hold a finding of high severity

sections.name: targeted
sections.title: Targeted
sections.summary: what the scripts name and what activities acted on
sections.note: hardcoded values: prior means no earlier output holds it, discovered means one does; subjects: each entity an activity acted on

sections.name: exposure
sections.title: Exposure
sections.summary: the usernames, emails, passwords, devices and addresses the files hold
sections.note: collected: first seen in an output; used: first seen in a script; a secret is masked

sections.name: impact
sections.title: Impact
sections.summary: what the findings mean, with what each concerns and the lines that show it

sections.name: remediation
sections.title: Remediation
sections.summary: what to do about them and to what, most urgent first

sections.name: mitigation
sections.title: Mitigation
sections.summary: what MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS say prevents the techniques found
sections.note: MITRE ATT&CK and ATLAS, for the techniques found
